Description: Sykesville is a historic town in southern Carroll County, Maryland, nestled along the Patapsco River just 20 miles west of Baltimore. Voted America's Best Main Street, Sykesville offers a picturesque small-town feel, vibrant community events, proximity to major healthcare at the Baltimore VA Medical Center, and convenient access to the Baltimore-Washington defense corridor.
